vya_text: gU0 - atha dhAtuSodhanam | svarNAdayaH ete saptadhAtavo vij~jeyAstAn budhaH taddoShaniHsAraNArthaM Sodhayet | tAraH raupyam iti, pittalo nAgaH, sIsakaH sIsakaM, tIkShNaloham || 1 || atha dhAtuSodhanaM | svarNAdidhAtUnAM patrANi tailAdau tridhA trivAraM agnau pratApayet taptvA taptvA niShiMcayet nirvApayet | evaM svarNAdilohAnAM SuddhiH saMprajAyate | nAgava~ggayorviSeSheNa SodhanamAha - tadA viSuddhiH syAt| nanu pittalaH kRutrimastatkathaM sapta ? -- ucyante, eke yaSadena saha sapta AhuH | tathAca `svarNaM rUpyaM ca tAmraM ca ra~ggaM yaSadameva ca | sIsaM lohaM ca saptaite dhAtavo girisamBavA iti | athaM svarNAdidhAtumAraNaM tatrAdau SAr~ggadharAnuktamapi svarNotpattiBedaSuddhASuddhalakShaNamAha - athotpattiH `purA nijASramasthAnAM saptarShINAM jitAtmanAM | patnyo vilokya lAvaNyaM lakShmIsampannayauvanAH || kandarpadarpavidhvastacetaso jAtavedasaH | patitaM yaddharApRuShThe retaH sauvarNatAmagAt ||' atha BedAH `prAkRutaM sahajaM vahnisaMBUtaM KanijaM tathA | rasendravedhasaMjAtaM svarNaM pa~jcavidhaM mataM || brahmANDaM saMvRutaM yena durlaBaM prAkRutaM hi tat | brahmavrataM tu sahajaM vahnijaM parikIrtitam | etatsvarNatrayaM divyaM varNairyaccASuBiryutaM | dhAraNAdeva tatkuryAcCarIramajarAmaraM || KanijaM KananAjjAtaM vedhajaM rasavedhataH | taccaturdaSavarNADhyaM BakShitaM sarvarogajit' || athASuddhasvarNaparIkShA - `SvetA~ggaM kaThinaM rUkShaM vivarNaM ca samardalam | dAhe cCede sitaM SvetaM GarShe cApi malaM tyajet' ||2-4||

dI0 - tAvat pUrvaM tatsaMKyAha yathA svarNeti | svarNAditIkShNAntAH sapta dhAtavo vij~jeyAH | viSeSheNa sapta dhAtavo boddhavyA: | yatastantrAntare aShTa dhAtava iti manyante tatrA~aShTadhA lohasaMj~jA | tathAhi - `svarNaM tAraM tAmranAgaM ra~ggaM kAntaM ca tIkShNakaM | muNDAntamaShTadhA lohaM kAMsyAraM GoShakaM tridhA | upalohaM samAKyAtam' ityAdi | tatastAn Sodhayedadha iti budhastadviSeShaj~jaH | tAn svarNAdIn atra svarNaM prasiddham, tAraM raupyam, AraM pItalohaM tacca tAmraGoShaBedAByAM saMjAtamityeke BAShante | atraiva GoShaBedo loke jasada iti vAcyaH | Sivamate tu devajAtatvena ShaDeva grAhyAH | tathAhi - Sivasya tejaH prathito rasendro devIBavaM gandhamathABrakaM ca | SulvaM tu sUryasya sahasraraSmeScandrasya raupyaM parameSvarasya || hemaM tu viShNoH praBavaM vadanti nAgaM ca nAgasya tu vAsukeSca | lohaM yamasyaiva tu kAlamUrterva~ggaM ca Sukrasya purAvido budhAH' iti | tasmAdArasaMj~jastvaupAdhikaH || 1 || svarNeti | suvarNAdInAM caturNAM patrANi kRutvA tAni cAgnau punaH saMtaptAni kRutvA vakShyamANadravyeShu tridhA trivelaM yathA syAnniShiMcayet pratyekamiti SeShaH | evaM suvarNAdInAM caturNAM viSuddhirBavati svarNAdilohAnamiti grahaNena tIkShNAdInAmapi SuddhirevaM boddhavyA | atra tailaM tilasaMBavaM ca takraM triBAgaBinnaM kA~jjikaM prasiddham kulattho~annaviSeShaH | atha nAgava~ggayorviSeShaSuddhiM darSayanAha - nAgeti | prataptAvityagnau saMtApitau ata eva gAlitAviti dravIBUtau kRutvA tairniShi~jcayediti#foot@haMDikAyAM dravANi pUrayitvA haMDikAmuKe ‘cilama’ saMj~jakaM dhUmrapAnayantroparyagnipAtramadhonAlIM kRutvA bandhayet, tacCidreNaiva nAgava~ggau punaHpunaH nirvApyau na tu drAvite va~gge dravANi sPuTatayA niShiMcayet | utplutya hi tau upadravaM kurutaH |# , taiH pUrvoktatailatakrAdidravaiH, tridhA tridheti pratyekaM tailAdi- BirniShi~jcayedityaBiprAyaH | viSeShamapi na kevalaM pUrvoktadravyairniShi~jcayet kiMtu ravidugdhenArkakShIreNA~api tridhA kRutvA Sodhayediti pUrvaSodhanAdayameva viSeShaH || 2-4 ||

dI0 - atha dhAtumadhye svarNamAraNamAha - svarNAcceti | sUtaM pAradaM tacca suvarNaparimANAt dviguNaM grAhyam | amlena bIjapUrAdinA tadgolakasamaM gandhamiti tat svarNapAradakRutena golakena sAmyaM SodhitagandhakaM saMgRuhya tadgolakasyAdhaH upari ca datvA SarAvasaMpuTe saMdhArya puTediti granthABiprAyaH | sampradAye ki~jcidgandhakaM datvA golakaM kAryaM paScAt SeShaM gandhamupari deyam | dRuDhasaMpuTa iti | dRuDhagrahaNena mRutkarpaTakaM sUcyate tena mRutkarpaTakenA~atra dRuDhatA kAryA | evaM caturdaSapuTaiH kRutvA nirutthaM jAyate suvarNamiti SeShaH | nirutthatA~atrAtyarthamUrcCanA kathyate na tu svarNasya mRutirBavati#foot@AdhunikA rasAyanaSAstraj~jAH svarNasyAtyantamUrcCanaiva Bavati na tu Basma iti vadanti | vividhaprakAraiH niShpannasvarNaviBUte rasAyanaSAstrato viSleShaNAt parIkShAyAM jIvatyeva | kevalaM tu cikkaNaprastara(sa~ggamarmara) caNakAmlalavaNayogataScotpannaM svarNAmlaM nirutthaM Bavati iti vadanti | # | puTamatra triMSadvanopalaiH kRutvA deyam | tacca kukkuTapuTasaMj~jayA vihitam | vanopalaM SuShkagomayam, tacca karaNDASabdavAcyam | gandho deyaH punaH punaH iti | SuddhagandhakaM ca pUrvoktavidhAnena pratyekaM puTaM yojyamityarthaH || 5 || 6 ||

vya_text: gU0 - kA~jcane svarNe gAlite nAgaM sIsakaM ShoDaSAMSena nikShipet | taccUrNayitvA amlena GRuShTvA golakaM kRutvA samaM gandhakaM UrdhvAdhaH SarAvasaMpuTe pUrvavat || 7-9 || anyacca kA~jcanArarasaiH samasUtakagandhayoH kajjalI hemapatrANi lepayet | samamAtrayA svarNasamamAtrayA, spaShTamanyat || 10-13 || anyadapi svarNamAraNaM | SilA manaHSilA sindUraM tayoH samayostulyayoScUrNam arkadugdhaM dadyAt | dhamettato hemni dugdhakaiH samaiva BAgato dadyAt dhamettato hemni gAlite samaH hemasamaH kalkaH dIyeta tato dhamet | yathA kalko na tiShThati evaM kShAratrayaM dadyAt svarNamRutirBavet || 14-16 || tathAca pArAvateti sugamam | anyacca granthAntarAt | daradaM hiMgulaM svarNatulyaM nAgaM sIsakaM mRutanAgacUrNaM vajrIkShIreNa marditam asya madhye suvarNasya kalkaSca mriyate iti svarNamAraNam || 17-20 ||

dI0 - aparamapi svarNamAraNamAha - kA~jcana iti | kA~jcane svarNe gAlite drAvite sati tatra nAgaM sIsakaM nikShipet ShoDaSAMSena kA~jcanaparimANAt nAgaM grAhyam | amlaM mAtulu~ggapratIkaM | adharottaramiti | golakasyopari cAdhaSca gandhakaM deyam | saMpuTavidhAnaM ca pUrvavat kAryam | kecidatra vanopalairviMSatisaMKyakaireva manyante evamityanena prakAreNa saptapuTaiH kRutvA hemaBasma Bavati ||7-5|| kA~jcanAreti | kA~jcanAro vRukShaviSeShaH prasiddhaH | tasya patrANAM tvaco vA rasaH svarasaH, sUtakaH pAradaH gandhakaSca samAnastayoH kajjalI kAryeti sambandhaH | hemapatrANi svarNapatrANi samamAtrayeti | tayA kajjalyA samayA svarNapatraparimANayA SeShaM vidhAnaM pUrvavat | kokilairiti SuShkagomayasaMj~jaiH a~ggArairvA yataH vahniM KarataraM kuryAditi grahaNAt evamityamunA prakAreNa puTatrayamityatrAgnerboddhavyam | athavA kA~jcanAraprakAreNa lA~ggalIprakAramapi jAnIyAt | lA~ggalI kalihArI, athavA jvAlAmuKIprakAramapi kA~jcanAraprakAravadboddhavyam| jvAlAmuKI jayantI sA caturvidhA Bavati `SvetA raktA tathA pItA kRuShNA jvAlAmuKI Bavet' iti | etajjAticatuShTayaM SvetA raktA raktAdikusumaiH kRutvA jAnIyAt || 10-13 | Sileti | SilA manaHSilA, sindUraH prasiddhaH, samayoH samAnamAnayoH, BAvanAparimANaM ca yAvaddravyaM plutaM Bavati gAlite pradrAvite hemni suvarNe kalko~ayamiti | ayaM kalkaH SilAsiMdUrajaH | kalkagrahaNena sAndro yojyaH | sama iti | svarNamAnasamaH kalka evamityamunA prakAreNa velAtrayaM trivAramityarthaH || 14-16 || pArAvateti | pArAvataH prasiddhaH malaM purIShaM liMpet iti hemapatrANItyarthaH | athavA kukkuTodBavairiti kukkuTastAmracUDaH tadudBavairmalairiti sambandhaH, teShAM svarNapatrANAmantarAntarAntaraM yathA syAt tathA svarNapatrasamaM gandhakacUrNaM deyaM tAni ca SarAvayugmasaMpuTe dhRutvA tatsaMpuTaM kukkuTapuTavidhAnena pAcyam, pa~jcaBirgomayopalairiti pa~jcasaMKyAkaiH SuShkagomayaiH evamityanena prakAreNa navasaMKyAkAni puTAni dadyAt | daSamaM ca mahApuTamiti mahApuTaM triMSadvanopalaiH kRutvA deyam || 17-20 ||

vya_text: gU0 - atha rajatotpattiBedAnAha granthAntarAt - `tripurasya vadhArthAya nirnimeShairvilocanaiH | nirIkShayAmAsa SivaH krodhena paripUritaH || tatastUlkABisamaye tasmAt kasmAcca locanAt | tato rudraH samaBavadvaiSvAnara iva jvalan || dvitIyasmAt paraM netrAddaSabindustu krAmukAt | tasmAdrajatamudBUtaM Sukrakarmasu saMsthitam' iti | atha tadBedAH - `sahajaM KanisaMBUtaM kRutrimaM ca tridhA mataM | rajataM pUrvapUrvaM hi svaguNairuttarottaraM | kRutrimaM rasavAdotthaM kiM vA rAmapadodBavaM | ni:kalmaShaM praBAhInaM dAhe cCede sitaM SuBaM | aSuddhaM sarvathA SodhyaM nAgaM dattvA vicakShaNaiH? iti | atha mAraNaM BAgaikamiti | spaShTamanyat || 21 || 22 |

dI0 - BAgaikamiti | tAlakaM haritAlaM BAgaikaM tArapatraBAgAdityarthaH, jambena jambIrakarasena amlagrahaNaM madhurajambIraniShedhArthaM, kenacidityanena kenApyamlena vA kutaH jambIrABAvAt tena cukrAdikamapi grAhyam, tena tAlakena saha BAgatrayamiti tArapatrANi raupyapatrANi pralepayet BAgatrayaM tAlakaparimANAt puTavidhAnaM pUrvavat triMSadvanopalairityanena mahApuTaM darSitam | evamityuktapuTavidhAnena caturdaSapuTakaM boddhavyam || 21 || 22 ||

vya_text: gU0 - anyacca | snuhIkShIreNa sehuNDadugdhena saMpiShTamAkShikaM svarNamAkShikaM mUtrAdau SuddhaM tAlakasya prakAreNa BAgaikatArapatrANi viBAgaM trilepayet punaH mUShAsaMpuTena ruddhvA caturdaSapuTaiH puTet | tAraM Basma prajAyate | granthAntare pAradena mAraNaM kRutaM tadapi liKyate tathAca `vidhAya piShTaM sUtena rajatasyAtha melayet| | tAlaM gandhaM samaM paScAnmardayennimbukadravaiH | dvitripuTairBavedBasma yojyametadrasAdiShu' iti | atha guNAH `rUpyaM SItaM kaShAyAmlaM svAdupAkarasaM saraM | vayasaH sthApanaM snigdhaM leKanaM vAtapittajit | pramehAdikarogAMSca nASayatyaciraM dhruvam || 23 || 24 ||

dI0 - arkakShIreNeti | AraM pItalohaM tacca tAmrasaMBavaM vadantyeke, tena gandhakakalkena samenArasamAnena SuddhAnyamladravairmuhuriti pUrvam ArapatrANi amladravairjambIrapraBRutikaiH muhuriti velAtrayaM viSuddhAni kRutvA paScAdgandhakakalkena lepayedityaBiprAyaH | gajapuTaM pUrvaM darSitameva evamityamunA prakAreNa puTadvayaM kAryam | AravadityAdi | kAMsyaM prasiddham | Aravadityanena SodhanamAraNe cAsya tadvadeveti boddhavyam | ekamiti grahaNena GoShamapi Aravaditi j~jeyam | viSuddhau mAraNe ca | tathAhi `kAMsyAraGoShapatrANi tena kalkena lepayet | ruddhvA gajapuTe paktvA SuddhimAyAnti niScitam | tAmravacca mRutiM teShAM kRutvA sarvatra yojayet' iti | GoShaM kAMsyaBedaH `jasada' iti loke || 25 || 26 || arkakShIravadityAdi | arkakShIraprakAravadajAkShIreNa gandhakakalkaM kAryam | tathA~anena prakAreNa nirguNDIsvarasena gandhakakalkaM kAryamiti prayogAntaram | tAmradInAM vadhe mAraNe | tAmrArarItyAraM, dhvaniH kAMsyaM, samagandhakayogata iti | dhAtusamAnagandhako grAhya ityaBiprAyaH || 27 ||

dI0 - ratnAnAM SodhanamAraNamapyAha - tAvatpUrvaM vajrasya SodhanamAha - kulatthaketi | vajraM hIrakaM | taccaturvidhaM Bavati | tathAhi - `SvetaraktapItakRuShNAScaturdhA vajrajAtayaH | rasAyane BavedvipraH SuBraH siddhyaShTadAyakaH || kShatriyo mRutyujidrakto valIpalitarogahA | dhanaprado BavedvaiSyaH pIto dehasya dArDhyakRut || kRuShNaH SUdro rujAM hantA vapustamBaM karoti ca | puMstrInapuMsakAScaite lakShaNena tu lakShayet|| suvRuttAH PalasaMpUrNAstejovanto bRuhattarAH | puruShAste samAKyAtA reKAbinduvivarjitA: || reKAbindusamAyuktAH ShaDasrAstAH striyaH smRutAH | trikoNadehadIrGaM ca tannapuMsakameva ca || pUrvapUrvaM tu te SreShThAH puruShA rasabandhakAH | SarIrakAntijanakA BogadA vajrayoShitaH | napuMsakAstvalpavIryA akAmA: satvavarjitAH | striyaH strINAM pradAtavyAH klIbe klIbaM tathaiva ca || sarveShAM sarvadA yojyAH puruShA balavattarAH' iti | anyatrA~api `pa~jca doShA guNAH pa~jca CAyA caiva caturvidhA | SvetA raktA tathA pItA kRuShNA caiva nigRuhyate || ShaTkoNaM laGu tIkShNaM ca bRuhadaShTadalaM ca yat | jale tarati tadvajraM tadgrAhyaM rasakarmaNi' iti | etasya SodhanAdikamapyAha - kulatthetyAdi | kulattho~annaviSeShaH prasiddhaH | kodravo~apyannaviSeShaH | kvAthena kRutvA dolAyantre vipAcayedityaBiprAyaH | taptamiti dolAyantrasveditaM tadvajraM paScAdagnau saMtaptaM kRutvA tadanu KaramUtre niShecayet | evaM trisaptadhA kRutvA mRutaM vajraM SreShThaM BavatItyarthaH | kecittu dolAyantre svedanam ahorAtreNaiva Bavati | tathAca tantrAntare `kulatthakodravakvAthe dolAyantreNa pAcayet | ahorAtrAt samuddhRutya hayamUtreNa BAvayet' iti || 79-82 ||

dI0 - vaikrAntamiti | vajravacCodhyamiti | yathA, vajraM pUrvaM SodhitaM kulatthAdikvAthena tathA vaikrAntamapi saMSodhya paScAnmArayedityaBiprAyaH | yato `vaikrAntaM vajraBedaM syAt' iti | keShAMcinmate caturvidhaM Bavati | vajram atra dvividhameva grAhyaM SreShThatvAt hayamUtreNa GoTakamUtreNa | taptaM taptamiti ko~arthaH ? taptvAgnau saMtApya mUtre AvapedityarthaH | evaM caturdaSavAraM yAvat kuryAt | tataH paScAt | vaikrAntaM meShadugdhaM tasya pa~jcA~ggaM tasya golakaM kRutvA tatra vaikrAntaM melayitvA paScAnmUShApuTe saMrudhyA~agnau pacet | meShadugdhaM meShadugdhikA tasyAH pa~jcA~ggamityarthaH, pa~jcA~ggaM tvakpatrapuShpaPalamUlAni | evaM saptadhA kRutvA BasmatAM yAti | kecittu meShadugdhasyetyasya sthAne `latAstvottara- vAruNyA' iti paThanti tasmAt pa~jcA~ggaM laGvindravAruNyA grAhyam | granthAntaradarSanAcca | (tathAhi `tataScottaravA- ruNyA pa~jcA~ggaM golakaM kShipet | ruddhvA mUShApuTe paScAtpaceduddhRutya golakAt | kShiptvA ruddhvA paceScaivaM saptadhA BasmatAM nayet' iti | vajrasthAne niyojayediti tadvaikrAntaM tasya kArye niyojayedityaBiprAyaH | ata eva vaikrAntaM vajravacCodhyamiti kathitam || 86 || 87 ||

dI0 - svedayediti | jayantI SAkaBedaH | maNimuktapravAlAnIti | maNayo nAnAvidhAste mANikyapuShpa- rAganIlamaNivaidUryagArutmatapraBRutayaH | muktA mauktikaM | te~api bahudhA Bavanti | pravAlaM vidrumaM tadapi bahuvidham, kumArI nArISabdavAcyA, taNDulIyo meGanAdaH#foot@caurA^^ISabdavAcyaH|# , stanyaM kShIraM, tena kimuktam | ratnAdIni pUrvaM dolAyantre jayantyAH svarasena saMsvedya yAmaikaM yAvat paScAt tadagnau saMtaptaM kRutvA kumAryAdInAmekatamarasena niShiMcayet | evaM saptadhA kRutvA mRutAni BavantItyarthaH | mauktAnIti bahuvacanatvenAShTaprakArANi teShAmucyante | tadyathA - `meGAnAmatha Sa~gKAnAM varAhasya ca dantinaH | mInajaM vaMSajaM caiva PaNijaM SuktijaM tathA | aShTau muktAPalAnyeva sadA jAraNakarmaNi | guNayuktAni gRuhyante doShayuktAni varjayet' | yataH - `sthUlaM vRuttaM guru snigdhaM raSmitArajalAnvitam | SvetamAhlAdakaM svacCaM muktAyASca guNA daSa' iti | pravAlAnIti bahuvacanenA~atrApi jAtiguNadoShAdikaM sUcayati | tathAhi `atiriktaM ca dIptaM ca vidrumaM parimaNDalam | snigdhaM ca svacCarUpaM ca baddhaM SuddhaM samaM guru || a~ggArasadRuSaM piNDaM pravAle~amI guNA daSa | gauraM ra~ggajalAkrAntaM sUkShmaM vakraM sakoTaraM || rukShaM kRuShNaM laGu SvetaM pravAlamaSuBaM tyajet | tathA ratnAnyaSeShata' iti | aSeShato~api tajj~jasakASAdavagantavyAni | teShAM ca lakShaNAni liKyante yathA - `padmarAgaM kuruvindaM sugandhaM nIlagandhakam | mANikyaM caiva vij~jeyaM brAhmaNAdikrameNatu || nirdhUmaM jvalada~ggAramindrago- pasamapraBam | gu~jjArAgapratIkASaM mANikyaM rasakarmaNi || cAmpeyakasamo varNairhemavarNaH sunirmalaH | atidIpto Bavedyastu padmarAgaH sa ucyate | sthUlavRuddhamadhucCAyaM BrAjiShNu Svetamujjvalam || guru snigdhaM tathA proktaM rasarAjasya karmaNi | indranIlo mahAnIlo nIlaSca kRuShNanIlakaH | ete nIlAstu catvAro brAhmaNAdikrameNa tu | atasIpuShpasa~gkASaM nIlajImUtasanniBam|| yaHkaroti payonIlaM mahAnIlaM taducyate | biDAlanetrasaMkASaM nIlapItaM sunirmalam || calaM lasunamadhyasthaM vaidUryaM rasakarmaNi | vij~jeyo garuDodgAraH kIrapakSho dvitIyakaH || tRutIyo vaMSapatraSca caturtho dhUlidhUsaraH | KadyotadyutisaMkASo mayUrakaMThasanniBaH || komalatvaM caturNAM supraSastaM rasakarmaNi, iti | kimuktaM bahunA `pa~jcadoShA guNAH pa~jca cCAyA caiva caturvidhA | SvetA pItA tathA raktA kRuShNA caiva nigRuhyate || sarve BAnuniBA dIptA doShAH paTalavarjitAH | nijairvarNaiH samAyuktA utkRuShTA rasakarmaNi' iti | atha prayogAntaramAha -uktamAkShikavadityAdi | pUrvoktasvarNamAkShikaSodhanavidhAnavat muktApravAlAni Sodhayet sarvaratnAni ca vajraSodhanamAraNavidhivat samprasAdhayedityaBiprAyaH || 88-91 ||

dI0 - SilAjatvityAdi | jaturlAkShA tatprakASavat SilAByaH prasrutaM dravaviSeShaM tat SilAjatuSabdavAcyam | tantrAntare~api `mAsi Sukre Sucau caiva SilAH sUryAMSutApitAH | catuHprakASaM svarasaM SilAByaH prasravanti hi | SilAjatviti viKyAtaM sarvavyAdhivinASanam' iti | nanu rUkShakaThinAnAM SilAnAM kathaM snigdhadravaH svarasaH saMBavati ? | satyam | atra SilopalakShitatvAt tattaddhAtava eva prasravanti | tathAcoktam `Sailasya dhAtoH svarasaM SilAByaH sUryapratApAjjatusaMprakASam | kRuShNaM BavenmUtrasamAnagandhi tadeva ramyaM tu SilAjatu syAt' iti | matAntare~api `hemAdyAH sUryasaMtaptAH sravanti giridhAtavaH| jatvABaM mRudu mRutsnAcCaM yanmalaM tacCilAjatu' iti | iti tantrAntare~api prasiddhametat| tadyathA `taptAdInAM tu lohAnAM ShaNNAmanyatamAnvayam | j~jeyaM svagandhataScApi ShaDyoniprathitaM kShitau' iti | yataH lohAdBavati tadyasmAcCilAjatu jatupraBaM | tasya lohasya yadvIryaM rasaM vApi biBarti tat' iti | prasa~ggato~api catuShTayaM yathA - `hemno vai rajatAt tAmrAt tathA syAdayasAdapi | gomUtragandhi sarveShAM yathApUrvamanuttamam' iti | anyatrApyuktam `trapusIsAyasAdIni pradhAnAnyuttarottaram | yathA tathA prayoge~api SreShThAH SreShThaguNAH smRutAH' iti | caturNAmapi muKyAnAM prasravaM SilAjatu catuShTayamatra guNaKyApanAya cAnyayonivAraNAya ca BavatIti| samAnIyeti atra samyag grahaNaM SreShThagrahaNanimittamavagantavyam | kathamasya SreShThatvamityatrAha kaScit - `teShu kRuShNaM malaM snigdhaM laGu ni:SarkaraM Bavet| gomUtragandhavaccApi tat pradhAnaM pracakShate' iti | grIShmataH praSilAcyutamiti yadyapyanyasmin kAle SilAjatuprasravaM dRuSyate tathApi grIShme KaratarakiraNatApitAByaH SilAByo guNavattaraM Bavati | godugdhairityAdibahuvacanAntaiH kRutvA bahuvAraM BAvayedityaBiprAyaH | BRu~ggo mArkavaH `GamarA' iti loke | atra BAvyasamAnakvathanIyaM dravyaM grAhyam | kvathanIyadravyamaShTaguNe jale niShkvAthya caturBAgAvaSiShTe kaShAye BAvayet | tacCuddhaM SuddhatAM vajrediti | nanu pUrvaM yacCuddhaM syAt tat kathaM paScAcCuddhatAM vrajedityatra SuddhaSabdadvayaM ca kimartham ? ucyate, pUrvaM SilAjatupiNDaM dhUpAdinA saMSodhya paScAdanena vidhinA SodhayedityadoShaH | tathAhi - `duShTauShadhikITapata~ggadaMSasaMtAlikAdoShanivAraNArtham | lohADhakau nimbaguDUcisarpiryavairyathAvat paridhUpayecca' iti | pUrvaSodhitameveti sarvasaMmatam || 92 || 93 ||
